system.description: Whether from thin blood or an uneducated lineage, the character's control over one or both of her physical Disciplines is lacking. At one point, Celerity may only be used for running and combat movement; activities requiring precision (saddling a mount, donning armor) are impossible while it is active, and attacks made while using it suffer +1 difficulty. At two points, the character's Potence must be actively restrained lest it wreak accidental havoc (breaking a friend's hand in a greeting, snapping a spine in a hug); an unsuccessful Willpower roll (difficulty 6) forces her to apply her full Potence to whatever she touches, and a failed melee attack costs her next action as she recovers her balance. At three points, the character's blood does not focus her strength effectively: Potence successes are not automatic but merely add dice to Strength and damage rolls, and even simple feats of strength (lifting a gate, overturning a cart) require a Strength + Potence roll (difficulty 6) whose result caps the dice available for the task. A character may only suffer one expression of this Flaw at a time, and it can be removed only through a lifetime or two of tutelage under a trained elder.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Three: Zealots
